release_notes: Fixed: the in-panel update button failed with "unable to unlink old 'frontend/dist/assets/index.js': Permission denied" on every install done by install.sh. The script chowned the tree to www-data and only afterwards built the frontend as root — and because Vite empties and recreates frontend/dist on each build, the bundle and its directory came out root-owned, which is exactly what git needs write access to in order to replace the file. The chown now runs last, after the frontend build and the MCP dependency install, so the whole tree (including .git) belongs to the web server. Existing installs need one manual chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/orbitra. Also fixed: uploading a landing ZIP reported a bare "ZIP upload error" with no cause — upload_landing now names each failure (post_max_size, upload_max_filesize, missing zip/fileinfo extension, a landings/ directory the web server cannot write to, a corrupt archive), a failed extraction is no longer reported as success, and every landing file operation shows the server's message instead of a generic one.
